title: phlegmariurus kajewskii
intro: Phlegmariurus kajewskii, commonly known as Kajewski's walking fern, is a species of fern in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a vascular plant that belongs to the division Lycopodiophyta, known for its unique ability to grow in a creeping manner, giving it the appearance of a walking plant. The health benefits of Phlegmariurus kajewskii include its potential to treat various conditions such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs due to its expectorant properties, which help to loosen and clear mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
